summary:
Main
Today, the DCE Iron ore futures were in the doldrums today, with the most-traded contract I2609 closing at 812.5 yuan/mt,down 0.98% from the previous trading session. Port spot prices fell 5-10 yuan from the previous trading day. Traders were relatively active in offering quotes; steel mills restocked on an as-needed basis; overall spot transactions were limited.
